errors.evidence: The figure's left y-axis maximum is 1,800,000, not 1,900,000.
The lowest bar on 2022-07-01 is approximately 300,000, not 3,000.
The x-axis time range is from 2022-07-01 to 2022-08-26, not 2023-09-30.
The left y-axis represents daily new confirmed cases (people), but the right y-axis represents news report counts, not people. The description incorrectly generalizes both axes as '人'.
The line representing news reports is blue, not black.
The legend and reference indicate the line represents '有关COVID-19新闻报道数量' (news report counts), not '感染报告'.
The description does not state the chart's purpose: showing the relationship between daily new COVID-19 cases and media coverage trends.
The description omits the right y-axis label, units, and range (news report counts, 0–6,000, step 1,000).
The description does not mention the x-axis uses weekly intervals for tick marks.
The description omits the legend explaining the blue-green bars (daily new cases) and the blue line (news reports).
The description does not mention the observed trend or relationship between the two data series (e.g., synchronization or lag).
The chart covers less than two months, not a full year.
The x-axis uses weekly intervals, not daily.
